program.name: Mind & Body Mix
program.subject: Variety
program.blurb: Core, balance, Pilates, mobility and yoga strength, a new pairing every day, ending with a stretch.
program.about: The calmer side of training, never the same twice. Each day deals one of twelve kinds of work, core, balance, mobility, Pilates, yoga strength, back care, hips, posture and more, with a format: straight sets, supersets, a circuit, an EMOM or a Tabata. Every day ends with a short stretch. Sixty days, no pair twice. Level II adds reps and Level III makes every hold longer.
program.split: Every day different · core, balance & mobility
